'''Yannick Lapointe Montreal Quebec 02-20-2000 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech on 21 February 2000 about [[February 2000 Montreal tournament]].<ref name="tr-d275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ montreal-quebec-02-20-2000], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 21 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-21-montreal-quebec-02-20-2000d275/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Yannick Lapointe won a 15-player tournament at Hyper Boréa in Montreal, Quebec, on 20 February 2000 with a Harvest Choke deck and a Court musicians deck, going 5–1 (10 (+121)) and losing only to Taylor Akinsson; Raphael Asselin was 2nd.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]] (byline: Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe)
* '''Published:''' 21 February 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Montreal Quebec 02-20-2000''
* '''Event:''' [[February 2000 Montreal tournament]]
* '''Event date:''' 20 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Montreal, Quebec
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Record:''' 5–1
* '''Points:''' 10 (+121)
* '''Light deck:''' [[Yannick Lapointe Harvest choke|Harvest Choke]]
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court with musicians and bounty hunters / Scum and Villainy, built 10 minutes before the event]]

== Original report ==

so i talk a little with old friend, revise some deck and the tournament begin

we where 15 and a lot of good player was there.

he activate 3 and does nothing else

in my turn play tunnel vision get han, deploy it with luke attack and that game
